policy: Continue the original final 4000-update model, AdamW state and torch RNG; retain original best validation checkpoint; constant terminal learning rate thereafter; one shared trajectory per seed
selection: lowest equally weighted three-corpus normal validation EER within each budget; earliest tie; also evaluate the fixed final checkpoint for each budget
test_policy: freeze all 18 checkpoints and validation FAR1pct thresholds before new test scoring; all tests previously observed
scope: fixed encoder, input data, model size, loss and batch size; tests additional optimization, not data scaling or a retuned learning-rate schedule
